notes.title: No Time To Loot + Release Date
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256196/17db6523949d7088cf2803fa716cac049ae36fca.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Abyss Chasers! [/p][p]I'm thrilled to announce that Abyss Chaser is featured in No Time To Loot event and is also going to be discounted for 20% during event sale :)[/p][p][/p][p]Also, this is the perfect time to announce the date of full 1.0 game release:[/p][p][/p][p]On 16.11.2025 so exactly half a year after Early Access launch you will be able to enjoy the full vestion of Abyss Chaser![/p]

notes.title: The Last Early Access Content Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45256196/136b0c953425d09681c26f4d7ffc2d2d127d892e.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the final content update before full 1.0 release! Abaddon can now finish his quest in hell by beating its last boss. You can also unlock all Weapons and Patrons in this expansion. [/p][p]This is not the end of Abaddon's journey though! The full release will feature the final biome (the titular Abyss), a new endless mode and of course the final boss and a true ending of the story.[/p][p]The full list of this update's content is:[/p][p]-Fourth Domain of Hell[/p][p]-New unique boss[/p][p]-New enemy type[/p][p]-New miniboss monster type[/p][p]-5 New Weapons[/p][p]-New Patron[/p][p]-8 New Achievements[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for the update about 1.0 Release Date![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
-Fixed Hellish Cauldron not granting the power sometimes
-Fixed Sensor not reveling miniboss room location
-Fixed Unseen questline ending dialog being unlocked too early

notes.title: Minor hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with Stage Select UI being locked when clicking on Fourth Domain of Hell in some cases.

notes.title: First Content Update
notes.notes: [p]The first major content update features the Third Domain of Hell which is inhabited by new enemy type. You can now challenge the defender of this domain, claim his amulet and proceed your chase for the Abyss with the found ally and arsenal of weapons.[/p][p][/p][p]Added:[/p][p]-New Hell level[/p][p]-Unique Hell boss[/p][p]-New Enemy type[/p][p]-New Miniboss type[/p][p]-3 new Weapons[/p][p]-New amulet[/p][p]-New Patron[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 5
notes.notes:
-You can now see how many drinks and items you have in the storage while in Aftermath shop menu.
-Added notifications when you get a new weapon/amulet in the Loadout Panel.
-Fixed a rare bug that caused fast-hitting weapons deal 0 damage when time was slowed.
-Secret Recipe achievement can be unlocked now.

notes.title: Drinks fix and update
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue causing the same drink to be unlocked multiple times
-Fixed Aftermath drink list overflowing in some rare situations
-Added closure to drink unlocking storyline
-Fixed several typos

notes.title: Micro Hotfix
notes.notes:
Super minor fix:
-In some rare cases list of items in the Armory overlapped the Abyss Dust counter.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.notes:
-Fixed too long drink names in Aftermath displayed incorrectly
-Fixed Workshop item hints
-Added missing Lamia miniboss tiles after unlocking Second Domain

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.notes:
-Fixed Workshop item list overflowing when too many weapons were collected
-Fixed Garage UI when items were fully upgraded
-Added missing Harbinger reward
-Minor tweaks to Vagabond modules

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
-Fixed some achievements not being unlockable.
-Fixed Aftermath currency icons being inconsistent.
-Minor balance tweaks for minibosses.

notes.title: Post launch hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented victory for some runs and displayed incorrect overworld map layout.
